newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 18.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Friday:
* A Mir astronaut mistakenly disconnected a critical cable, disabling the guidance system causing yet another crisis for the craft.
* Newt Gingrich removed Rep. Bill Paxon from the top appointed post on the Speakers leadership team.
* A deadly epidemic is emerging in the Sudan.
* Another Miami killing has widened the search for the suspected murderer of Gianni Versace.
* Woolworth Corp said it would shutter all 400 of its remaining five-and-dime stores.
* As New York's first prolonged heat wave of the summer continues, the virtues of air conditioning are being debated.
* The chancellor of the City University of New York said she would leave in mid-September to become the president of the University of Alabama.
